notes.content:
Fixed a problem with Stage Special 1 where the finish line was off
Other minor modifications

Fixed the failure to get the Special Stage All S results.
Fixed the special stage leaderboards not being reflected on the leaderboards
Fixed that the volume setting at the start of the game is not reflected.
Stage name is now displayed after clearing a stage

notes.title: 1.1 Update
notes.content:
Special Stage added
You can play from Stage 1 to Stage 9 with Rank S.

Fixed a strange behavior when grabbing with both hands.
Fixed certain yellow bars disappearing suddenly
Other minor fixes.

notes.title: ver1.02
notes.content:
The reflection in the leaderboard was not well fixed.
(Just go to the menu screen and everything you've done so far will be reflected.)
Additional text from Dr.
Fixed an issue where the score is always overwritten when reclearing.

notes.title: Announcement of the 1.01 update
notes.content:
Adjusting the Stage 3 bar position.
Fixed the leaderboard function not being connected.
Fixed a problem with the gimmick continuing to move when posing.
Fixed a spelling error in English.
Rankings support all Stages
It's harder to open both legs.

notes.content:
